name: Quantum Error Correction Benchmark Framework
description: A proposed framework and evaluation methodology to compare quantum error-correcting codes across practical metrics (e.g., logical error rates, thresholds, resource overhead) under realistic noise models.
evaluation_method: logical error rate, threshold estimation, resource-overhead measurements (e.g., qubit-count, gate-depth)
general_score_metric: logical error rate (primary), plus threshold and resource-overhead metrics
reputation: Proposed research framework with initial interest among quantum error-correction researchers but limited broad adoption pending community tooling and standardization.
notes: Framework results are highly sensitive to chosen noise models and simulation assumptions; computationally expensive simulations; not an ML benchmark per se but a systems/simulation evaluation suite.
